priority_items.summary: Recapture HTML /warnings/ 200 at 23:56 prints NEW Special Weather Bulletin Number ONE for Northern Cooks on Tropical Depression 02F ISSUED 142321 UTC. Gale Warning now in force for Penrhyn, Manihiki and Rakahanga. Centre [1004 HPA] near 9.1S 158.2W or about 20 km WSW of Penrhyn at 0900UTC as printed; slow moving, expected WSW movement next 6–12h; 65 km/h gusts 90 km/h within 24h; risk of coastal inundation during high tides. First SWB on TD02F for Northern Cooks; next issue 160300UTC as printed. FMS RSS item 20023 lastBuild NEW 23:22:06 +1200; HTTP LM NEW 11:22:06 GMT. Leftover TDS 142116 UTC still listed as item 20036 (09.0S 158.7W / 1004 hPa / LOW TO MODERATE). Recapture ABPW web 200 at 23:56:13 still prints ABPW10 PGTW 141300 COR (web LM HOLD 13:18:12 GMT; tgftp LM HOLD 13:21:05 GMT): INVEST 95P still 9.2S 157.1W, ~853 NM ENE of Pago Pago, 28–33 kt / 1004 mb, potential HIGH. Leftover WTPS21 PGTW 141300 TCFA (tgftp LM HOLD 13:00:33 GMT): numbered warnings not justified; TCFA MSLP 998 mb; reissue by 151300Z. WTPS31 leftover 19 Oct. CAP GU/MP/AS empty (updated 23:48:30Z first-pass / 23:55:08Z recapture-pass). Cook Islands News 403. USGS catalog count 18 first-pass / 17 recapture; catalog-add leftover-dated OOS M4.7 east central Pacific 22:23:46Z. No this-window Oceania M4.5+. NEW Nadi Gale Warning is not a named cyclone and not Category-level. JTWC HIGH + TCFA HOLD is not a numbered warning. Not FLASH.
